nativeBaseline.reference: native navigation landmark and anchors with current-page semantics

library: Preserve destination and current-page semantics; prevent unavailable controls from misleading users.
consumer: Author navigation and link names and destinations; own routes, loading and result state.

notes: #1286 removed fabricated labels and updated the consuming data-table example.
Destination pagination uses authored native links; omit an unavailable destination or omit its href and supply meaningful static text. Do not fake navigation or mutate application-owned current page.
Public-port fixtures exercise SSR/native navigation, keyboard focus, no-href boundaries and narrow wrapping; exact-head, cross-browser and manual evidence remain required.
Audit mapping is provisional; not a conformance claim.
